description: Build an e-commerce platform where customers browse a product catalog, place orders, and pay online. Orders reserve stock from inventory; payments are processed through an external payment provider; customers get email confirmations.
Build me a blog platform with user accounts and post management
A logistics system that tracks delivery vehicles in real time, assigns routes to drivers, monitors driver rest periods for compliance, and notifies dispatchers when shipments are delayed.

A clinic appointment system: patients book, reschedule, and cancel appointments; practitioners manage their availability; reminders go out via SMS and email; an audit trail records every change for compliance.

A double-entry ledger for a small bank: accounts hold balances, transfers move money atomically between accounts, every transaction is immutable and auditable, and suspicious activity is flagged for review.
An IoT platform that ingests telemetry from thousands of sensors, detects anomalies in the readings, raises alerts to operators, and lets engineers manage device registration and firmware versions.
Subscription billing for a SaaS product: customers pick plans, are invoiced monthly through Stripe, can upgrade or downgrade mid-cycle with proration, and dunning emails are sent on failed payments.
additionalContext: The payment provider must stay behind an anti-corruption layer.
